queries_run: Lear zonal architecture business model shift 2026 seating E-Systems

findings.claim: Lear 10-K 說明客戶傳統上硬體與軟體一併採購；E-Systems 正轉向 zonal 架構、並退出部分電子產品線（音響、燈光、車載充電器、telematics、利基控制器）。屬產品組合調整，非銷售通路（D2C／訂閱／平台）轉變；直接賣給全球 OEM 的模式未變。
findings.excerpt: we are de-emphasizing and exiting certain electronics product lines, including audio modules, lighting modules, on-board chargers, telematics control units and niche electronic controllers, where we do not see a path to sustainable risk-adjusted financial returns.

note: 搜尋 1 次未找到通路去中介化、D2C、訂閱或平台化的來源；僅有上述產品組合調整。未再搜尋其餘 query。
